arms.P: the protocol arm refitted (features as they come); gate: per-seed accuracy and confusion matrix equal slice_<k>.npz's / combined.npz's
arms.Z: the same features with a StandardScaler fitted on the outer training fold
arms.families: first 4 fPCA scores of the slice (0-9) or the 40 scores of all ten slices (all)
arms.control: kept fraction of the slice (0-9) or the ten kept fractions (all)

intervals: paired bootstrap over slides of seed-averaged per-slide values, shared indices default_rng(12345).integers(0, 123, (4000, 123)); scaling: Z - P (accuracy), P - Z (log-loss)
